advsec_get_alerts.description: Retrieve Advanced Security alerts for a repository. Results are scoped to the specified project and repository. Branch filters (onlyDefaultBranch, ref) apply only to code, dependency, and license alerts; they are not applicable to secret alerts and are ignored by the service, so they neither include nor exclude secrets. To narrow secret alerts by confidence, pass a single 'confidenceLevels' value ('High' or 'Other'); selecting every level is treated as no confidence filter.

alertType.description: Filter alerts by type. If not specified, returns all alert types.

confidenceLevels.description: Only applicable to secret alerts. Accepted values are 'High' and 'Other'. Pass a single value (e.g. ['High']) to narrow secrets to that confidence level. Leave unset to return secrets without a confidence filter. Do not select both levels to widen results: the Alerts service does not accept a multi-value confidence filter and would return no alerts, so this tool treats an all-levels selection as no filter and omits it.

onlyDefaultBranch.description: For non-secret alerts: if true (the service default when omitted) only return alerts found on the default branch; if false, return alerts from all branches. Ignored when 'ref' is provided. Not applicable to secret alerts and ignored by this tool when alertType is 'Secret'. When alertType is unspecified, this filter is still sent and may exclude secret alerts from the results; query alertType 'Secret' separately to retrieve all secrets.

orderBy.description: Order results by specified field. Defaults to 'severity'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

ref.description: Filter non-secret alerts by git reference (branch), e.g. 'refs/heads/main'. When omitted and onlyDefaultBranch is true, only alerts on the default branch are returned. Not applicable to secret alerts and ignored by this tool when alertType is 'Secret'. When alertType is unspecified, this filter is still sent and may exclude secret alerts from the results; query alertType 'Secret' separately to retrieve all secrets.

repository.description: The name or ID of the repository to get alerts for.

severities.description: Filter alerts by severity level. If not specified, returns alerts at any severity.

top.description: Maximum number of alerts to return. Defaults to 100.

validity.description: Only applicable to secret alerts. If omitted, alerts of all validity statuses are returned (no validity filter is applied). Filtering by validity may return fewer alerts than 'top'; use the continuation token to fetch any remaining alerts.

projectId.description: The project ID of the Azure DevOps project (note: project name is not valid).

pullRequestId.description: The ID of the pull request to link to.

pullRequestProjectId.description: The project ID containing the pull request. If not provided, defaults to the work item's project ID (for same-project linking).

repositoryId.description: The ID of the repository containing the pull request. Do not use the repository name here, use the ID instead.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item to link to the pull request.

wit_list_backlog_work_items.description: Retrieve a list of backlogs of for a given project, team, and backlog category

backlogId.description: The ID of the backlog category to retrieve work items from.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team.

wit_list_backlogs.description: Receive a list of backlogs for a given project and team.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team.

wit_list_work_item_comments.description: Retrieve list of comments for a work item by ID.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

top.description: Optional number of comments to retrieve. Defaults to all comments.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item to retrieve comments for.

wit_list_work_item_revisions.description: Retrieve list of revisions for a work item by ID.

expand.description: Optional expand parameter to include additional details. Defaults to 'None'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

skip.description: Optional number of revisions to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.

top.description: Optional number of revisions to retrieve. If not provided, all revisions will be returned.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item to retrieve revisions for.

wit_my_work_items.description: Retrieve a list of work items relevent to the authenticated user.

includeCompleted.description: Whether to include completed work items. Defaults to false.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

top.description: The maximum number of work items to return. Defaults to 50.

type.description: The type of work items to retrieve. Defaults to 'assignedtome'.

wit_query.description: Retrieve work item query data for a project. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: get (get a query by ID or path), get_results (run a saved query and return results), wiql (execute an ad-hoc WIQL query).

depth.description: Depth of expansion. Used for: get. Defaults to 0.

expand.description: Expand parameter to include additional details. Used for: get.

id.description: The ID of the saved query. Required for: get_results.

includeDeleted.description: Include deleted items. Used for: get. Defaults to false.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

query.description: The ID or path of the query. Required for: get.

responseType.description: Response type: 'full' returns complete results (default). 'ids' returns only work item IDs and supports flat queries only; any other query type is not supported. Used for: get_results.

team.description: Team name or ID. Used for: get_results, wiql.

timePrecision.description: Include time precision in date fields. Used for: get_results, wiql.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. Used for: get_results, wiql. Defaults to 50.

useIsoDateFormat.description: Use ISO date format in the response. Used for: get. Defaults to false.

wiql.description: The WIQL query string to execute. Required for: wiql. Example: "SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project".

wit_update_work_item.description: Update a work item by ID with specified fields.

id.description: The ID of the work item to update.

updates.description: An array of field updates to apply to the work item.

op.description: The operation to perform on the field.

path.description: The path of the field to update, e.g., '/fields/System.Title'.

value.description: The new value for the field. This is required for 'Add' and 'Replace' operations, and should be omitted for 'Remove' operations.

wit_update_work_item_comment.description: Update an existing comment on a work item by ID.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to update.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item.

updates.description: An array of updates to apply to work items. Each update should include the operation (op), work item ID (id), field path (path), and new value (value).

format.description: The format of the field value. Only to be used for large text fields. e.g., 'Html', 'Markdown'. Optional, defaults to 'Html'.

id.description: The ID of the work item to update.

op.description: The operation to perform on the field.

path.description: The path of the field to update, e.g., '/fields/System.Title'.

value.description: The new value for the field. This is required for 'add' and 'replace' operations, and should be omitted for 'remove' operations.

wit_work_item.description: Retrieve work item data. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: get (get a single work item by ID), get_batch (get multiple work items by IDs), list_comments (list comments on a work item), my (get work items relevant to the authenticated user), list_revisions (list revisions of a work item), list_for_iteration (list work items for a team iteration), get_type (get metadata for a work item type).

asOf.description: Retrieve the work item as of a specific date. Used for: get.

continuationToken.description: Token for continuing paged results. Used for: list_comments.

expand.description: Expand options (None, Fields, Relations, Links, All). Used for: get, list_revisions. For get, cannot be combined with fields.

fields.description: Field names to include in the response. Used for: get, get_batch. For get, cannot be combined with expand.

id.description: Work item ID. Required for: get.

ids.description: Work item IDs. Required for: get_batch.

includeCompleted.description: Include completed work items. Used for: my. Defaults to false.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Optional for get; when omitted, the work item is retrieved at organization scope. For other actions, a project selection prompt will be shown if omitted.

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Used for: list_revisions.

team.description: Team name or ID. Used for: list_for_iteration.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. Used for: list_comments, my, list_revisions. Defaults vary by action.

type.description: Type of work items to retrieve. Used for: my. Defaults to 'assignedtome'.

workItemId.description: Work item ID. Required for: list_comments, list_revisions.

workItemType.description: Work item type name. Required for: get_type.

wit_work_item_attachment.description: Download a work item attachment by its ID. By default returns the content as a base64-encoded resource. If savePath is provided, saves the file locally to that directory and returns the file path instead. Useful for viewing images (e.g. screenshots) or other files attached to work items such as bugs. If a project is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

attachmentId.description: The GUID of the attachment. Found in the attachment URL: https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_apis/wit/attachments/{attachmentId}.

fileName.description: The file name of the attachment, e.g. 'screenshot.png'. Used to determine the MIME type or the saved file's name.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

savePath.description: Optional local directory path where the downloaded file should be saved. Must be a relative path (e.g. 'temp' or 'downloads/attachments') to an existing directory that resolves (including symlinks) inside the server's working directory; absolute paths are not allowed. If provided, saves the attachment to this directory and returns the file path. If omitted, returns the content as a base64-encoded resource.

wit_work_item_attachment_link.description: Link an uploaded attachment to a work item using the attachment URL returned by wit_work_item_attachment_upload.

attachmentUrl.description: The attachment URL returned by wit_work_item_attachment_upload.

comment.description: Optional comment to include with the attachment link.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item to link the uploaded attachment to.

wit_work_item_attachment_upload.description: Upload base64-encoded content as a new work item attachment. This tool only uploads the attachment; use wit_work_item_attachment_link separately to link the returned attachment URL to a work item.

fileName.description: The name of the file to upload, e.g. 'screenshot.png'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

wit_work_item_comment_write.description: Write operations for work item comments. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: add (add a comment to a work item), update (update an existing comment on a work item).

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to update. Required for: update.

format.description: Format of the comment text. Optional, defaults to 'Markdown'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

text.description: The comment text. Required for: add, update.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item. Required for: add, update.

wit_work_item_link_write.description: Write operations for work item links. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: link (link two work items together), unlink (remove links from a work item), link_to_pull_request (link a work item to a pull request), add_artifact_link (add a repository, branch, commit, or build artifact link to a work item).

artifactUri.description: The complete VSTFS URI of the artifact. Used for: add_artifact_link. If provided, individual component parameters are ignored.

branchName.description: The branch name. Used for: add_artifact_link (Branch type).

buildId.description: The build ID. Used for: add_artifact_link (Build, Found in build, Integrated in build types).

comment.description: Comment to include with the artifact link. Used for: add_artifact_link.

commitId.description: The commit SHA hash. Used for: add_artifact_link (Fixed in Commit type).

id.description: Work item ID to remove links from. Required for: unlink.

linkType.description: Type of artifact link. Used for: add_artifact_link. Defaults to 'Branch'.

pageId.description: The numeric wiki page ID. Used for: add_artifact_link (Wiki type). Takes precedence over pagePath.

pagePath.description: The full wiki page path. Used for: add_artifact_link (Wiki type) when pageId is not provided.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

projectId.description: The project ID (GUID). Required for: link_to_pull_request, and add_artifact_link (Git/Wiki types).

pullRequestId.description: The pull request ID. Required for: link_to_pull_request; used for: add_artifact_link (Pull Request type).

pullRequestProjectId.description: Project ID containing the pull request. Used for: link_to_pull_request. Defaults to projectId.

repositoryId.description: The repository ID. Required for: link_to_pull_request and add_artifact_link (Git types).

type.description: Link type to remove. Required for: unlink.

updates.description: Link operations to apply. Required for: link.

id.description: The ID of the work item to update.

linkToId.description: The ID of the work item to link to. Required unless type is 'hyperlink'.

url.description: The URL for a hyperlink. Required when type is 'hyperlink'.
URL to match when removing a link. Used for: unlink. If not provided, all links of the specified type are removed.

wikiId.description: The wiki ID (GUID). Used for: add_artifact_link (Wiki type).

workItemId.description: The work item ID. Required for: link_to_pull_request, add_artifact_link.

wit_work_item_unlink.description: Remove one or many links from a single work item

id.description: The ID of the work item to remove the links from.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

type.description: Type of link to remove. Options include 'parent', 'child', 'duplicate', 'duplicate of', 'related', 'successor', 'predecessor', 'tested by', 'tests', 'affects', 'affected by', and 'artifact'. Defaults to 'related'.

url.description: Optional URL to match for the link to remove. If not provided, all links of the specified type will be removed.

wit_work_item_write.description: Write operations for work items. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: create (create a new work item), update (update fields on a single work item), update_batch (update multiple work items in one call), add_child (create child work items under a parent).

batchUpdates.description: Updates for multiple work items. Required for: update_batch.

format.description: Format for large text fields. Optional.

id.description: The work item ID to update.

value.description: The new value for the field.

fields.description: Field values to set on the work item. Required for: create.

format.description: Format for large text fields. Optional.

id.description: Work item ID to update. Required for: update.

items.description: Child work items to create. Required for: add_child.

areaPath.description: Optional area path for the child work item.

description.description: The description of the child work item.

format.description: Format for the description. Defaults to 'Markdown'.

iterationPath.description: Optional iteration path for the child work item.

title.description: The title of the child work item.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent work item. Required for: add_child.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

updates.description: JSON Patch operations for fields and relations on a single work item. Required for: update. For a safe read-modify-write, prepend a test operation on "/rev" with value set to the numeric revision returned by the preceding read; Azure DevOps rejects the entire update if the current revision differs.

op.description: The operation to perform. Use 'test' with path '/rev' to enforce optimistic concurrency.

path.description: The path to operate on, e.g. '/fields/System.Title' or '/rev' for a revision test.

value.description: The JSON operation value, including objects and arrays. Required for add, replace, and test; omit for remove. Pass relation objects directly, not as JSON strings. For a test on '/rev', pass the numeric revision previously read.

workItemType.description: The type of work item. Required for: create, add_child.

wit_work_items_link.description: Link work items together in batch.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

comment.description: Optional comment to include with the link. This can be used to provide additional context for the link being created.

id.description: The ID of the work item to update.

linkToId.description: The ID of the work item to link to.

type.description: Type of link to create between the work items. Options include 'parent', 'child', 'duplicate', 'duplicate of', 'related', 'successor', 'predecessor', 'tested by', 'tests', 'affects', and 'affected by'. Defaults to 'related'.

work.description: Retrieve work-related data for a project or team. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: list_iterations (list all iterations in a project), list_team_iterations (list iterations assigned to a team), get_team_settings (get team settings including default iteration and area path), get_team_capacity (get team capacity for an iteration), get_iteration_capacities (get capacity for all teams in an iteration).

depth.description: Depth of children to fetch. Used for list_iterations. Defaults to 2.

excludedIds.description: An optional array of iteration IDs, and their children, to exclude from results. Used for list_iterations.

iterationId.description: The Iteration ID. Required for get_team_capacity and get_iteration_capacities.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team. Required for list_team_iterations, get_team_settings, and get_team_capacity. Reuse from prior context if already known.

timeframe.description: The timeframe for list_team_iterations. Only 'current' is supported.

work_assign_iterations.description: Assign existing iterations to a specific team in a project.

iterations.description: An array of iterations to assign. Each iteration must have an identifier and a path.

identifier.description: The identifier of the iteration to assign.

path.description: The path of the iteration to assign, e.g., 'Project/Iteration'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team.

work_capacity_write.description: Update the team capacity of a team member for a specific iteration in a project.

action.description: The action to perform. Only 'update' is supported.

activities.description: Array of activities and their daily capacities for the team member.

capacityPerDay.description: The capacity per day for this activity.

daysOff.description: Array of days off for the team member, each with a start and end date in ISO format.

end.description: End date of the day off in ISO format.

start.description: Start date of the day off in ISO format.

iterationId.description: The Iteration Id to update the capacity for.

project.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps project.

team.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps team.

teamMemberId.description: The team member Id for the specific team member.

work_create_iterations.description: Create new iterations in a specified Azure DevOps project.

iterations.description: An array of iterations to create. Each iteration must have a name and can optionally have start and finish dates in ISO format.

finishDate.description: The finish date of the iteration in ISO format (e.g., '2023-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Optional.

iterationName.description: The name of the iteration to create.

startDate.description: The start date of the iteration in ISO format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Optional.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

work_get_iteration_capacities.description: Get an iteration's capacity for all teams in iteration and project. If a project is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

iterationId.description: The Iteration Id to get capacity for.

project.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

work_get_team_capacity.description: Get the team capacity of a specific team and iteration in a project. If a project is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

iterationId.description: The Iteration Id to get capacity for.

project.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

team.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps team. Reuse from prior context if already known.

work_get_team_settings.description: Get team settings including default iteration, backlog iteration, and default area path for a team. If a project or team is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a team selection prompt will be shown.

work_iteration_write.description: Create or assign iterations in an Azure DevOps project. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. 'create' creates new iterations in the project; 'assign' assigns existing iterations to a team.

iterations.description: An array of iterations to process. For create: provide iterationName and optional dates. For assign: provide identifier and path.

finishDate.description: The finish date of the iteration in ISO format (e.g., '2023-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Used for create.

identifier.description: The identifier of the iteration to assign. Used for assign.

iterationName.description: The name of the iteration to create. Used for create.

path.description: The path of the iteration to assign, e.g., 'Project/Iteration'. Used for assign.

startDate.description: The start date of the iteration in ISO format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Used for create.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team. Required for assign.

work_list_iterations.description: List all iterations in a specified Azure DevOps project. If a project is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

excludedIds.description: An optional array of iteration IDs, and thier children, that should not be returned.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

work_list_team_iterations.description: Retrieve a list of iterations for a specific team in a project. If a project or team is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a team selection prompt will be shown.

timeframe.description: The timeframe for which to retrieve iterations. Currently, only 'current' is supported.

work_update_team_capacity.description: Update the team capacity of a team member for a specific iteration in a project.

activities.description: Array of activities and their daily capacities for the team member.

capacityPerDay.description: The capacity per day for this activity.

daysOff.description: Array of days off for the team member, each with a start and end date in ISO format.

end.description: End date of the day off in ISO format.

start.description: Start date of the day off in ISO format.

iterationId.description: The Iteration Id to update the capacity for.

project.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps project.

team.description: The name or Id of the Azure DevOps team.

teamMemberId.description: The team member Id for the specific team member.
